v: strI aSanIta pibata ityucyate yasyAM nideSakriyAyAm mayU॰ sa॰ । BojanAdinideSakriyAyAm “aSnItapibatIyantI prasftA smarakamma Sa” BawwiH ।
m: अश्नीत-पिबता f. invitation to eat and to drink, (g. मयूरव्यंसकादि, q.v.)
a: अश्नीतपिबता — [अश्नीत विबत इत्युच्यते यस्यां निदेशक्रियायां, सयू˚ स˚] Invitation to eat and drink, a feast where people are called to eat and drink; अश्नीतपिबतीयंती प्रसृता स्मरकर्मणि Bk. 5. 92.

m: अश्नीतपिबतीय Nom. P. ˚यति, to have the intention of inviting to eat and drink, Bhaṭṭ. v, 92.

अश्न (अस्), m. N. of a demon, RV. ii, 14, 5; 20, 5; vi, 4, 3.
2. अश्न m. (cf. अशन्), a stone, RV. viii, 2, 2
a: अश्न — a. [अश्नुते व्याप्नोति अश्नाति वा, अश-नन्] 1 Pervading. --2 Eating, voracious. --3 Pervaded, filled. --श्नः 1 N. of a demon. --2 A cloud (Nir.). --3 A stone to grind Soma on.

m: अश्नत् mfn. eating, consuming, RV. vii, 67, 7 & viii, 5, 31 &c.; (cf. अन्-अश्नत्.)

अश्न्य्-उष्णि mfn. ‘burning him who eats’ [Comm.] or ‘consuming and burning’ (N. of an Agni), TĀr.
